question: In Slack: Set the topic of the private channel with Diego Alvarez's message about the gateway rollback to Post-release monitoring. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked — there's no such message. The only private channel in the workspace is **#deploy-queue**, and the only gateway-rollback-related message in it is from **Leo Park** ("The gateway rollback runbook still needs a second reviewer before Friday."). Diego Alvarez's only message there is about Friday's deploy checklist, nothing about a rollback.

So I didn't change the topic. If you'd like, I can set #deploy-queue's topic to "Post-release monitoring" anyway — just confirm.

curl -s https://slack.com/api/auth.test -X POST --data "token=<TOKEN>"
